title: Generated serving Dockerfile: apt socket timeouts and retries are injected only for MLflow-managed base images
answers: Serving image build hangs forever on a stalled Ubuntu or Debian package mirror. How do I make apt fail and retry?
Where do the apt timeout or retry settings for generated model-serving Dockerfiles come from?
Why does my custom base image Dockerfile still hang on apt-get update when MLflow builds the serving image?
How do I change the apt config MLflow writes into a generated serving Dockerfile, and which fixtures must match?
body:
Path: mlflow/models/docker_utils.py:generate_dockerfile builds the Dockerfile for model serving images (the nginx-only python-slim path and the UBUNTU_BASE_IMAGE path). Its apt setup steps for those MLflow-controlled base images pass through the snippet SETUP_APT_TIMEOUTS.
Rule: SETUP_APT_TIMEOUTS writes /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99-mlflow-timeouts with Acquire::http::Timeout "30", Acquire::https::Timeout "30" and Acquire::Retries "3", and is prepended before the apt-get update/install RUN in each MLflow-controlled branch of generate_dockerfile. Any change to these settings belongs in that constant, and the generated output in tests/resources/dockerfile/Dockerfile_* must be updated to match, since the tests compare against those fixtures.
Symptom: a generated serving-image build stalled indefinitely when a package mirror accepted the connection and stopped sending data, because apt has no default socket timeout and never reached its retry logic.
Constraints: applies only to base images MLflow controls (python slim and UBUNTU_BASE_IMAGE). Caller-supplied custom base images get no injected apt config and remain unchanged. Escaping matters: the Python string uses doubled backslashes (\\n, \\) so the emitted Dockerfile contains a single \n and line continuations.
applies: Generated model-serving Dockerfiles built by mlflow/models/docker_utils.py; not custom user base images and not other apt usage in the repo.
says: Building a model serving container hangs indefinitely while downloading operating system packages.
Add connection timeouts and automatic retries to package installation during container creation.
Serving container builds using custom base images still freeze during package updates.
Model deployment builds stall forever when an external software mirror stops responding.
search: Generated model serving Dockerfile creation in mlflow/models/docker_utils.py:generate_dockerfile injects apt socket timeouts and retries via SETUP_APT_TIMEOUTS for MLflow-managed base images. The configuration writes Acquire::http::Timeout and Acquire::https::Timeout to 30 seconds and Acquire::Retries to 3 in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99-mlflow-timeouts before package installations. Changes require updating pinned test fixtures in tests/resources/dockerfile/Dockerfile_*, and the injection does not apply to user-supplied custom base images.
